messages:
sam_sales: Hey @dealdesk_mike @security_jane — heads up: SchoolAI (YC S22, edtech) asking for an $8k credit for a 6-week POC. Heavy embeddings + chat. They also sent a security questionnaire and asked if we can do a temporary dedicated instance. Need quick guidance on approval path and any required guardrails.

luis_solutions: quick Q: what's expected daily token burn/RPS and primary success metric? we can recommend embedding batch size/shorter context to lower cost. :thinking_face:

security_jane: send the SCQ link and I'll triage. For hosted POC we can do redacted logs + upload limited SIEM exports. Dedicated will require infra review and ~2w provisioning. Also need contact for SOC/DPA questions.

dealdesk_mike: baseline: we can approve up to $5k one-off POC credits under standard dealdesk terms (usage cap, 60d expiry, no stacking). Anything >$5k needs either a consumption commit or exec approval. Ask for ARR projection + exec sponsor.

sam_sales: They estimate $0-12k ARR Y1 but CTO (nina_cto) expects to convert to $3k MRR if POC goes well. CTO is sponsoring. Could we structure $6k credits with a 6-month convert option?

emma_ae: We can do $6k if they sign a 6-month minimum commit (e.g., $1k/mo) OR we agree that 50% of unused credits convert to the first committed month. Require SCQ closure within 10 calendar days. Note: dedicated infra adds provisioning fee per our rate card. Ping legal. :raised_hands:

dealdesk_mike: If they commit to $1k/mo for 6 months, I will approve $6k credits. Terms: credits expire 60 days, overage billed at standard PAYG rates, no promo stacking. Need written ARR projection + PRD link + SSO/SCIM ETA.

devex_bot: Posted: https://internal.redwood/poc-templates — POC playbook + sample addendum + rate card snippet.

security_jane: I'll review the SCQ tonight if they share it. For hosted POC w/ redacted logs we can move faster; for dedicated, start infra request now (2wk lead). Also require KMS decision (customer-managed or Redwood) for keys.

sam_sales: Sending SCQ link + SOC report now. They also asked if our "Founders Week" promo can be stacked with dealdesk credits.

dealdesk_mike: No stacking. Founders program credits are separate; we do not allow stacking with bespoke dealdesk credits unless explicitly approved by legal + finance.

luis_solutions: Operational note: will set model config to smaller context embeddings for POC, enable prefix caching, and add token guardrails in the session config. This should keep expected burn <= 2M tokens over 6 weeks.

emma_ae: I'll loop in legal to draft the POC addendum and cover the convert-to-commit clause. Sending to legal queue with high priority.

sam_sales: Great — action items: sam to collect signed SCQ and exec sponsor note; luis to post config and expected token projections; security_jane to review SCQ & advise on KMS; dealdesk_mike to prepare credit terms; emma_ae to draft addendum. Will update when I have the signed doc. Thanks all! :thumbsup:

luis_solutions: sample credit terms (for reference):
```
POC_CREDITS: $6000
expiry_days: 60
usage_cap_tokens: 2000000
convert_option: true
commit_threshold_monthly: $1000
provisioning_fee_dedicated: $1500 (one-time)
```

security_jane: :eyes: received SCQ link, starting review. If they want dedicated, flag will go to eng-infra for provisioning ETA.

dealdesk_mike: I'll draft the credit memo once we have the signed sponsor note and SCQ ack. Please cc me on any legal threads."
